correctness.rationale: The unique alternating parity track supplies a residue-mod-four certificate for every length n>=8 divisible by four. Rotations preserve this phase modulo four; interleaving lifts are well-defined, target conjugacy cannot merge separate source classes because the even track is alternating and the odd track is not, and each source factor yields exactly two distinct occurring target rotations. The complete proof treats arbitrary instruction sequences and the boundary n=8. Two distinct finite-word generation routines and 216 finite checks passed; the infinite theorem is proved symbolically.

Ordinary factor complexity and canonical position counts do not directly determine restricted cyclic orbit profiles. Accessible mathematical claims checked for overlap contain no implication covering the paperfolding transfer; historical-priority uncertainty remains.

value.rationale: A full restricted orbit-size distribution, not merely a total factor count, transfers exactly under dyadic decimation at all sufficiently large multiples of four for uncountably many paperfolding words. This gives a structural solution on infinitely many lengths including mixed-orbit cases beyond published power-of-two full-orbit results, and yields same-word stabilization for regular paperfolding.
